blocks.text: Patient Intake Attestations
Version 1.0  |  Effective [EFFECTIVE DATE]  |  Last updated October 2, 2026

**How to read this form.** Each part is a table. "What the patient sees" is the exact wording. "Reviewed by" means: System, an automatic rule in GEN Health; WellPeps (non-clinical), WellPeps support staff who check only account, shipping and eligibility details and never judge health answers; Clinician, a licensed clinician of OSI Medical Services, P.A. (the Practice).
Before you start (shown at the top of the form)

Please answer every question honestly and completely. Your answers help clinicians of the Practice decide whether and how they can treat you. A clinician of the Practice, not WellPeps, reviews your health answers and makes every medical decision. Answering these questions does not make you a patient of the Practice. That happens only when a clinician accepts you.

**This form is not for emergencies.** If you think you are having a medical emergency, call 911. If you are in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.

blocks.text: Part B. Where you are right now (a short form asked every time)
*Shown with every new order, every refill and every request for a visit.*

rows: In which state are you physically located right now?
Dropdown: states served, plus Another state or outside the United States. Disqualifier: any answer outside all 50 states
If this is different from the state you live in, how long will you be there?

I understand that clinicians must be licensed where I am physically located during my care. I will update my location before every visit, refill or request for care, and I will not ask for care while I am outside all 50 states. [VERIFY: care while outside the state]
I understand that state rules may limit where medicine can be shipped. I will give a delivery address where I can receive it safely.

blocks.text: Part C. Your health: questions for everyone [MEDICAL DIRECTOR TO CONFIRM]

rows: Which of these do you have, or have you ever had? Choose all that apply: heart disease or heart rhythm problem; high blood pressure; low blood pressure; stroke; diabetes or prediabetes; kidney disease; liver disease; thyroid disease; any cancer; pancreas, gallbladder, stomach or bowel disease; blood clotting or blood disorder; seizures; mental health condition; eating disorder; none of these.
Tell us more about anything you chose, and about any other medical condition.

List every medicine you take: prescription medicine, over-the-counter medicine, vitamins, supplements, hormones and peptides, including anything you got from another source. Include the dose. Write "none" if you take nothing.
Do you have any allergies to medicines, foods, dyes or other products?
If yes, list each allergy and what happened.
Have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine like the one you are asking about?
Radio: Yes, No, Not sure; Long Text if yes
Are you pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or breastfeeding?
Radio: Yes, No, Not applicable to me
Have you been in the hospital or had surgery in the last 12 months?
Radio: Yes, No, Not sure; Long Text if yes
Do you smoke or vape, drink alcohol, or use recreational drugs? Tell us how much.

rows: Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer, or are you being checked for cancer or a tumor?

Do you have diabetes or prediabetes, or have you had low blood sugar?
Do you take a medicine that can raise serotonin, such as an SSRI, an SNRI, an MAOI or St. John's wort?

Do you take a blood thinner?

blocks.text: Part E. Your primary care provider

rows: Do you have a primary care provider (PCP)?
PCP name, clinic and phone or fax number
The Practice's clinician may send information about my care to my PCP. I can change my mind at any time. (Optional.) [VERIFY: PCP notice]
Radio: Yes, No. See HIPAA Authorization Forms
I understand that this service does not replace my primary care. I am responsible for following up with my own doctor for ongoing care and for any problem the clinician tells me to have checked.

blocks.text: Part F. Emergency contact

rows: I agree that the Practice may contact this person, and emergency services, if a clinician believes I am in danger.

blocks.text: Part G. Truthfulness and your responsibilities

rows: My answers are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I have not left out anything about my health, my medicines or my allergies.
I will tell the clinician right away if anything changes, such as a new medicine, a new condition, pregnancy or a side effect.
I understand that wrong or missing information can cause serious harm, and that a clinician may decline to treat me or end my care if I give false information.
I understand that a clinician of the Practice decides whether I can be treated, that a prescription is not guaranteed, and that WellPeps is not a medical practice.
I understand that this form is not for emergencies. I will call 911 in an emergency, and call or text 988 if I am in crisis.
I understand that care by telehealth has limits, as the Informed Consent to Telehealth Services and Treatment explains, and that I will read and sign it.
